$comment: MODELED pro-forma assumptions for scoring/financing (spec 003/004). These are NOT real comps. Rents especially are modeled until a rent-comp source is wired (PropStream/Rentometer). Real inputs (assessed value, zoning, beds, owner, coordinates) come from the ingested DB; THESE fill the gaps and are flagged 'modeled' in every output. Per-market so the engine works for all markets, not one. Sources: examples/*.md hand-runs + RESEARCH-FINDINGS Stream 4.

rentModel.$comment: MODELED, spatially-aware: per-bed rent decays with distance to campus. Calibrated so ~0.5mi off-prime ≈ $825/bed and stays within the $735-900 research band. Replace with a real rent-comp source when available.
